name: extension_campaign

experiments.$comment: Block 1a — baseline: same concentrated-5 branch failures, NO islanding extension.  Sub-islands lose load that the LP can't recover because there's no grid-former in the island.
experiments.name: extension_islanding_off

experiments.$comment: Block 1b — same seeds + failures, islanding extension enabled + every generator promoted to GridForming.  Sub-islands containing a promoted gen can self-anchor and continue serving their local loads.  Comparison vs 1a quantifies the islanding extension's served-load uplift on the SCARE agent stack.
experiments.name: extension_islanding_on

experiments.$comment: Block 2a — baseline: cp_heavy_dependent + generator failures + tight slack (0.15).  The CP layer is the only lever to close the deficit.  No temporal extensions.
experiments.name: extension_temporal_off

experiments.$comment: Block 2b — same seeds + setup, gas linepack + thermal LTC enabled on the monee net.  In single-step mode this is a no-op other than per-pipe linepack_kg / per-junction t_pu tracked vars.  Smoke test: same PWSF as 2a (within solver tolerance), zero solver_failures, zero CP-role crashes on the augmented obs schema.  When timeseries mode is wired through mango_energy_environments, the comparison becomes the actual flex-uplift test.
experiments.name: extension_temporal_on

experiments.$comment: Block 3 — community partition method sweep.  Single ablation block with two rows: the default {} (label_propagation, radius=2) and the alternative modularity (distributed-Louvain Phase 1).  Same seed set + scenario across both rows so the partition method is the only varying knob; per-claim deltas isolate the community-formation effect on priority_invariant / heat_priority / monotonic_progress.  connected_component is exercised separately via the component_level variant and is intentionally not duplicated here.
experiments.name: extension_community_formation
